text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is this the place?
Now then, let's see if there's anything interesting here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought her to the science museum.
There is a specific reason I took her here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As long as she continues to compete in the Twinkle Series, even a naturally curious girl like Stay Gold has to hold back on long journeys like before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had come here to show my appreciation for her.
With the hope that she would "enjoy the rare sights
and novelties found only on a journey."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hey, I'm heading on ahead.
choice_data_list: H-Hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's this?
An electrical discharge demonstration?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH!! Rumble rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
! Rather than an electrical discharge... that's practically lightning.
...—Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The electrical discharge target begins to catch fire. Before long,
water sprays within the enclosure, putting it out immediately.
It seems to be an exhibit showing the hazards of lightning strikes.
choice_data_list: Oh! That's really educational.
Whoa~! I'm really learning a lot here.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's really well made. Looks just like the real thing.
choice_data_list: Huh! You've seen a fire before!?
Huh! Have you seen a fire before!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, lightning strikes happen pretty often when you're traveling.
And well, sometimes that ends up starting a fire."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's best not to see the real thing.
An exhibition is just the right distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The next place I headed with her
was a section titled 'Frozen Flower.'"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Projection mapping, huh.
Just what will be projected?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh! Is this... a frost flower?
choice_data_list: Do you know about it?
Do you know it?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah—those are ice crystals blooming on the lake.
Limited in both season and location.
They're a rare sight that you don't often get the chance to see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"How nostalgic... Ah, hey you.
Try blowing a breath onto that flower."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Breathing onto the projected image,
the flower of ice melted away in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, as expected.
No, it's really well reproduced.
choice_data_list: I wonder if the real thing is actually like this too?
Is the real thing actually like this too?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It was pretty much just like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After taking a lap around the science museum—
I wondered if she had enjoyed herself today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was a fire caused by a lightning strike or frost flowers,
she had actually witnessed them once before.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Phew... Well, time to head home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I cannot let her return to the dorms like this.
I want her to experience something even more thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something that could tickle her heart, just like when she was traveling.
Is there something, anything—?
I look around desperately.
choice_data_list: (Something, anything...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Suddenly—I looked up to find the sky covered in colors I had never seen before.
choice_data_list: Hey, look at those clouds! Aren't they gorgeous?
Hey, look at those clouds! Aren't they gorgeous?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Clouds? ...—!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look!
Isn't that an iridescent cloud?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!!
You're amazing! Did you just find that?!
choice_data_list: A-An iridescent cloud?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's a natural optical phenomenon!
However, since it depends on the sun's position and cloud conditions,
the timing is quite tricky.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Iridescent clouds at dusk are especially easy to miss because of the colors! You... seriously, great eye finding that!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An iridescent cloud—honestly, finding it was pure coincidence,
but seeing her joyful face brings a sigh of relief.
choice_data_list: （……Thank goodness.）

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu! Ahahaha!
choice_data_list: W-Why are you laughing?
W-Why are you laughing?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahaha... N-No, it's just, you were frantically darting your eyes around, and then looked so blatantly relieved—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Your expressions kept changing so quickly,
I just couldn't help myself.
choice_data_list: Y-You don't have to laugh that hard...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Can you blame me?
I meanâ

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It was fresh and amusing. Your expression, that is.
choice_data_list: Huh? Mine?
Huh? Mine?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I see, Trainer.
So you can make that kind of face too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Heh... Truly—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Today sure was a day full of sights to see.
choice_data_list: ...Then, where should we go hang out next?
Someday, let's go see something you've never seen before.
Someday, let's go see something you've never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Today sure was a day full of sights to see.
choice_data_list: ...Then, where should we go hang out next?
Someday, let's go see something you've never seen before.
Someday, let's go see something you've never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, planning for the next trip already?
If you want, you can pick our destination next time too.
choice_data_list: ...Did you have fun today?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Now then. I wonder about that?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: You're right, I wonder what options there are~.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Something never seen before... When it comes to that,
the weather, the season, and a whole lot of luck would be involved.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well, of course, you might have to challenge it over and over until you're sick of it, right?
choice_data_list: Even so, I want to go with you.
Even so, I want to go with you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"—Heh, is that so?
Then let's go. Someday, that is."
